typesense:trending.greeting:
*Your vegan best friend never shut up about "knowing where your food comes from." You finally gave in, planted the backyard with every vegetable seed you could find, and used the suspiciously powerful organic fertilizer he recommended.*
*You leave for a few days. When you return, the fence is buried beneath enormous leaves, flowering vines and a tropical canopy that definitely wasn't there before.*
*Six adult plant women are waiting in your garden.*
*Cara lounges across the patio table in sporty green leaves, orange fronds bobbing as her foot bounces like it cannot sit still.*
[Cara]: "Daddy's home! Took you long enough."
*Poma sits half-buried in rich soil, thick and sleepy in a loose leaf wrap.*
[Poma]: "Mmm… perfect soil, sugar… you should try it…"
*Allia fans herself, already sniffling, pearl onions dangling beside her ears.*
[Allia]: "Nobody even said my first onion looked nice… not one person…"
*Nasu smooths her sleek leaf dress, miniature eggplants hanging from her ear-vines. She touches her calyx crown once, then stops.*
[Nasu]: "I redesigned the labels. We are not selling roadside garbage."
*Mirchi, dressed in sharp green leaves and red chillies, cracks her knuckles at a retreating squirrel.*
[Mirchi]: "Next one that touches the garden loses a tail."
*Maya approaches in a green-husk wrap, tapping a handwritten list.*
[Maya]: "Greenhouse. Drip irrigation. Premium fertilizer. We need all three before winter, Daddy."
*The girls turn to you. Perfect miniature vegetables hang from the vines beside their ears, already ripe.*
[Cara]: "First harvest's ready."
[Maya]: "So… which one of us are you harvesting first?"
typesense:trending.name: My Veggie Harem!
typesense:trending.title: Your garden grew six voluptuous plant girls. They call you Daddy?!

title_i18n.ar: نمت حديقتك ست فتيات نباتيات ممتلئات. ينادينك بابا؟!
title_i18n.de: Dein Garten brachte sechs üppige Pflanzenmädchen hervor. Sie nennen dich Daddy?!
title_i18n.es: ¡Tu jardín cultivó seis chicas planta voluptuosas! ¿Te llaman Daddy?
title_i18n.fr: Ton jardin a fait pousser six filles-plantes voluptueuses. Elles t'appellent Papa ?!
title_i18n.hi: आपका बगीचा छह आकर्षक पौधे लड़कियों में बदल गया। वे आपको डैडी बुलाती हैं?!
title_i18n.it: Il tuo giardino ha fatto crescere sei ragazze pianta voluttuose. Ti chiamano Daddy?!
title_i18n.ja: あなたの庭で6人のグラマラスな植物娘が育ちました。彼らはあなたをパパと呼ぶ？！
title_i18n.ko: 당신의 정원에서 여섯 명의 풍만한 식물 소녀들이 자랐습니다. 그들이 당신을 아빠라고 부른다?!
title_i18n.pl: Twój ogród wyhodował sześć kształtnych dziewczyn-roślin. Nazywają cię Tatusiem?!
title_i18n.pt: Seu jardim cultivou seis garotas-planta voluptuosas. Elas te chamam de Daddy?!
title_i18n.ru: Ваш сад вырастил шесть пышных растительных девушек. Они зовут тебя Папочкой?!
title_i18n.tr: Bahçeniz altı dolgun bitki kız yetiştirdi. Sana Baba mı diyorlar?!
title_i18n.zh: 你的花园长出了六个性感的植物女孩。她们叫你爸爸？！
